live.expected_reply: At sunrise, the station keeper opened the north gate and wrote the date in a blue notebook. A small ferry waited beside the landing while two crew members checked the ropes and counted the life jackets. Across the river, a gardener watered the rows of beans and placed a basket under the old pear tree. The baker brought six loaves to the counter and left a handwritten note beside the bread. By noon, the air was warmer and the wind had turned toward the hills. The last passenger folded a paper map, thanked the crew, and followed the stone path into town.
